datasets.name: ds_cfo_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT MEASURE(revenue) AS revenue, MEASURE(contribution_margin) AS contribution_margin, MEASURE(cm_pct) AS cm_pct, MEASURE(cost_to_serve) AS cost_to_serve
FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv
WHERE (:quarter = 'All' OR CAST(ledger_quarter AS DATE) = try_cast(:quarter AS DATE))
  AND (:segment = 'All' OR segment = :segment)
  AND (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
  AND (:product_family = 'All' OR product_family = :product_family)

datasets.name: ds_cfo_trend
queryLines:
SELECT ledger_month, MEASURE(contribution_margin) AS contribution_margin, MEASURE(revenue) AS revenue
FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv
WHERE (:quarter = 'All' OR CAST(ledger_quarter AS DATE) = try_cast(:quarter AS DATE))
  AND (:segment = 'All' OR segment = :segment)
  AND (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
  AND (:product_family = 'All' OR product_family = :product_family)
GROUP BY ledger_month ORDER BY ledger_month

datasets.name: ds_cfo_family
queryLines:
SELECT product_family, MEASURE(contribution_margin) AS contribution_margin,
  CASE WHEN MEASURE(contribution_margin) < 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Profit' END AS margin_result
FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv
WHERE (:quarter = 'All' OR CAST(ledger_quarter AS DATE) = try_cast(:quarter AS DATE))
  AND (:segment = 'All' OR segment = :segment)
  AND (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
  AND (:product_family = 'All' OR product_family = :product_family)
GROUP BY product_family ORDER BY contribution_margin ASC

datasets.name: ds_cfo_class
datasets.displayName: Cost stack by legacy or strategic (margin_ledger_mv)
queryLines:
SELECT INITCAP(family_class) AS family_class, MEASURE(network_expense) AS network_expense, MEASURE(cost_to_serve) AS cost_to_serve, MEASURE(contribution_margin) AS contribution_margin
FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv
WHERE (:quarter = 'All' OR CAST(ledger_quarter AS DATE) = try_cast(:quarter AS DATE))
  AND (:segment = 'All' OR segment = :segment)
  AND (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
  AND (:product_family = 'All' OR product_family = :product_family)
GROUP BY INITCAP(family_class)

datasets.name: ds_cfo_circuits
queryLines:
SELECT circuit_id, customer_id, product_family, INITCAP(family_class) AS family_class, network_type, vendor_id,
  MEASURE(contribution_margin) AS contribution_margin, MEASURE(cm_pct) AS cm_pct, MEASURE(revenue) AS revenue, MEASURE(network_expense) AS network_expense, MEASURE(cost_to_serve) AS cost_to_serve
FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv
WHERE (:quarter = 'All' OR CAST(ledger_quarter AS DATE) = try_cast(:quarter AS DATE))
  AND (:segment = 'All' OR segment = :segment)
  AND (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
  AND (:product_family = 'All' OR product_family = :product_family)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY contribution_margin ASC LIMIT 25

datasets.name: ds_cfo_rule
queryLines:
SELECT allocation_rule_version, MEASURE(cost_to_serve) AS cost_to_serve
FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv
WHERE (:quarter = 'All' OR CAST(ledger_quarter AS DATE) = try_cast(:quarter AS DATE))
  AND (:segment = 'All' OR segment = :segment)
  AND (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
  AND (:product_family = 'All' OR product_family = :product_family)
GROUP BY allocation_rule_version

datasets.name: opt_quarter
queryLines: SELECT 'All' AS quarter UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT CAST(CAST(ledger_quarter AS DATE) AS STRING) FROM (SELECT ledger_quarter FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv GROUP BY ledger_quarter)

datasets.name: opt_segment
queryLines: SELECT 'All' AS segment UNION ALL SELECT segment FROM (SELECT segment FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv GROUP BY segment) WHERE segment IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: opt_region
queryLines: SELECT 'All' AS region UNION ALL SELECT region FROM (SELECT region FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv GROUP BY region) WHERE region IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: opt_product_family
queryLines: SELECT 'All' AS product_family UNION ALL SELECT product_family FROM (SELECT product_family FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv GROUP BY product_family) WHERE product_family IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: ds_wall_kpis
queryLines: SELECT MEASURE(wall_target) AS wall_target, MEASURE(identified_savings) AS identified_value, MEASURE(gap_to_wall) AS gap_to_wall, MEASURE(wall_progress_pct) AS progress_pct FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_onebillion_wall_mv

datasets.name: ds_wall_levers
queryLines: SELECT lever, owner_persona, source_metric AS source_metric_view, MEASURE(identified_savings) AS identified_value FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_onebillion_wall_mv GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY identified_value DESC

datasets.name: ds_wall_trend
queryLines:
-- Challenge card values: MEASURE(identified_savings) per owner persona from margin_onebillion_wall_mv (lever grain, no month). CM is never redefined here (DEC-002).
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN owner_persona = 'Finance' THEN identified_value END) AS finance_value,
       MAX(CASE WHEN owner_persona = 'Ops' THEN identified_value END) AS ops_value,
       MAX(CASE WHEN owner_persona = 'Sales' THEN identified_value END) AS sales_value
FROM (SELECT owner_persona, MEASURE(identified_savings) AS identified_value
      FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_onebillion_wall_mv GROUP BY owner_persona)

datasets.name: ds_card_answers
datasets.displayName: $1B Wall challenge card answer key (margin_ metric views)
queryLines:
-- $1B Wall challenge card answer key. Every value is a MEASURE() from a margin_ metric view; CM is never redefined here (DEC-002). Sales as-of DATE'2026-11-19' (DEC-019).
WITH fin AS (
  SELECT product_family, MEASURE(contribution_margin) AS cm
  FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv
  WHERE ledger_quarter = DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', ADD_MONTHS(DATE'2026-11-19', -3))
  GROUP BY ALL HAVING MEASURE(contribution_margin) < 0),
ops AS (
  SELECT MEASURE(grooming_candidate_count) AS cand, MEASURE(candidate_monthly_cost) * 12 AS annual_cost, MEASURE(est_annual_savings) AS annual_savings
  FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_offnet_spend_mv),
sal AS (
  SELECT MEASURE(renewal_count) AS renewals, MEASURE(below_floor_renewal_count) AS below_floor, MEASURE(below_floor_renewal_revenue) AS bf_revenue
  FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_renewal_floor_mv),
mkt AS (
  SELECT segment, MEASURE(cm_pct) AS cm_pct, ANY_VALUE(portfolio_cm_pct) AS portfolio_cm_pct
  FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_segment_growth_mv WHERE room_to_grow = 'Yes' GROUP BY ALL),
led AS (
  SELECT MEASURE(revenue_leakage) AS leakage, MEASURE(carrier_rate_variance) AS rate_variance
  FROM cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv)
SELECT 1 AS card_no, 'Legacy losses' AS card, 'Finance' AS persona,
  'Which product families lost money after cost to serve last quarter?' AS genie_question,
  CONCAT('Q3 2026: ', ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(product_family, ' ', FORMAT_NUMBER(CAST(cm AS DECIMAL(38,2)), 2)))), '; ')) AS expected_answer,
  'margin_ledger_mv' AS source_metric_view FROM fin
UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Off-net grooming', 'Ops', 'Which off-net circuits run next to our own fiber, and what do we pay for them?',
  CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER(cand, 0), ' grooming candidates; annual off-net cost (what we pay) ', FORMAT_NUMBER(CAST(annual_cost AS DECIMAL(38,2)), 2), '; est. annual savings if moved on-net ', FORMAT_NUMBER(CAST(annual_savings AS DECIMAL(38,2)), 2)),
  'margin_offnet_spend_mv' FROM ops
UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Renewals below the margin floor', 'Sales', 'Which renewals in the next 90 days are below the margin floor?',
  CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER(below_floor, 0), ' of ', FORMAT_NUMBER(renewals, 0), ' renewals (with ledger activity) below floor; revenue at stake ', FORMAT_NUMBER(CAST(bf_revenue AS DECIMAL(38,2)), 2)),
  'margin_renewal_floor_mv' FROM sal
UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Room to grow', 'Marketing', 'Which segments have the highest margin and the most room to grow?',
  CONCAT(segment, ': CM ', FORMAT_NUMBER(CAST(cm_pct * 100 AS DECIMAL(38,1)), 1), '% vs portfolio ', FORMAT_NUMBER(CAST(portfolio_cm_pct * 100 AS DECIMAL(38,1)), 1), '%, revenue share below customer share'),
  'margin_segment_growth_mv' FROM mkt
UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Revenue Leakage', 'Finance', 'How much Revenue Leakage is there to recover?',
  CONCAT('Revenue Leakage ', FORMAT_NUMBER(CAST(leakage AS DECIMAL(38,2)), 2)), 'margin_ledger_mv' FROM led
UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'Carrier Rate Variance', 'Ops', 'How much Carrier Rate Variance did carriers bill us above the contract rate?',
  CONCAT('Carrier Rate Variance ', FORMAT_NUMBER(CAST(rate_variance AS DECIMAL(38,2)), 2)), 'margin_ledger_mv' FROM led
ORDER BY card_no

# Challenge cards
Find your biggest lever. Pick a card, ask Margin Genie, check the answer.

### Legacy losses
Persona: Finance

"Which product families lost money after cost to serve last quarter?"

Check: Answer key row 1, and Page 1 'Which product families lose money after cost to serve?' (Quarter = Q3 2026)

### Off-net grooming
Persona: Ops

"Which off-net circuits run next to our own fiber, and what do we pay for them?"

Check: Answer key row 2, and Page 2 lever 'Off-net grooming' (est. annual savings, not spend)

### Renewals below the margin floor
Persona: Sales

"Which renewals in the next 90 days are below the margin floor?"

Check: Answer key row 3, and Page 2 lever 'Renewal margin floor'

### Room to grow
Persona: Marketing

"Which segments have the highest margin and the most room to grow?"

Check: Answer key row 4, and Page 1 Contribution Margin % with the Customer Segment filter

### Revenue Leakage
Persona: Finance

"How much Revenue Leakage is there to recover?"

Check: Answer key row 5, and Page 2 lever 'Revenue leakage recovery'

### Carrier Rate Variance
Persona: Ops

"How much Carrier Rate Variance did carriers bill us above the contract rate?"

Check: Answer key row 6, and Page 2 lever 'Carrier rate variance recovery'

### Ask Margin Genie
One Genie for Finance, Ops, Sales, and Marketing. Margin means contribution margin from margin_ledger_mv.

Open the Genie panel (top right) to ask Lakelink Fiber Margin Genie.
